statement:
let f := fun k : ℕ => 4*k^2+1; let roots := fun (q : ℕ) => (Finset.range q).filter (fun r => q ∣ f r); let rho := fun q : ℕ => ((roots q).card : ℝ); let count := fun A B d : ℕ => ((Finset.Ioc A B).filter (fun k => d ∣ f k)).card;
∀ A B D : ℕ, A≤B → 1≤D →
  (∑ d ∈ (Finset.Icc 1 D).filter (fun d => Odd d ∧ Squarefree d),
    |(count A B d : ℝ) - ((B-A : ℕ) : ℝ) * rho d / d|) ≤
    (D : ℝ) * (1 + Real.log D)

plain_statement.en: New route · Levent GRH and natural extensions · QP-0074 · Sum window remainders for odd squarefree moduli up to any level D

brief.zh: 在模奇数 d 下用 r↦2r 搬运 QP-0014 的根数。每根的区间取整误差至多一。以 ρ(d)≤τ(d) 加总，再用成对约数的调和和。
brief.en: Transport the QP-0014 root count by r↦2r modulo odd d. The rounding error per root is at most one. Sum ρ(d)≤τ(d) by pairing divisors and using the harmonic sum.
